answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a walnut spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a summit header. Producing 45 answers an epoch therefore costs 24 real forward passes, and the mirror record lets any auditor recompute the check. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
